questions.question: In your current consulting role, how do you turn requirements into software requirements specifications and design specifications for a multi-platform system?
Describe a time you coordinated work between an onsite team and an offshore team. How did you assign work, validate deliverables, and address issues?
You have worked in Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall environments. How would you select and adapt a delivery process for a cross-functional software initiative with changing priorities?
What is your approach to estimating development and testing effort for a new feature, and how do you communicate delivery risks or dependencies to stakeholders?
Describe the architecture of a .NET application you have built involving a WPF or WinForms client, a middle tier, and SQL Server. What responsibilities belonged in each tier?
The role requires leadership across internal developers and external vendors. How would you establish coding standards, design-review practices, and accountability for a distributed development team?
What experience do you have with code reviews, unit testing, component integration testing, and integration testing? How do you decide what should be covered at each level?
This role oversees secure web applications and APIs. How would you approach input validation, authentication, authorization, encryption, and protection of sensitive data in a new application?
How would you assess and modernize an existing internal application portfolio while balancing new feature requests, technical debt, operational support, budget, and available engineering capacity?

Your background includes C#, C++, ASP.NET, SQL Server, and JavaScript. How would you approach leading a team responsible for PHP-based CMS platforms and modern JavaScript applications while ensuring sound technical decisions?
